content:
alex: quick escalation — new customer `clearmap` onboarding. Console shows an API key for them, but their SDK calls are getting 401s. The key is visible in console but under `archive-proj-031` instead of `clearmap-prod`.

maria: thx. can you paste the curl repro and the exact error body? also customer id?

alex: customer id 100283. repro:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_3xAMPLEKEY\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
```
response headers/body:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Key not scoped to this project"}
```

ryan: that error looks like a project-scope mismatch. can you fetch the key metadata from internal admin?

alex: ran the admin lookup: `GET /internal/keys/sk_live_3xAMPLEKEY` returned:
```json
{"key":"sk_live_3xAMPLEKEY","project":"archive-proj-031","scopes":["inference"],"status":"active","created_by":"provisioner-service"}
```

onboard-bot: provisioning-event: service_role_claim_bound claim=claim-0b12 project=archive-proj-031 provisioner=oidc-provisioner-2 status=success

maria: hmm, provisioning bound the claim to the wrong project. that can happen if the onboarding slug collides with an archived project slug or if the claim rebinding retry hit an old project. did this tenant recently re-use a slug?

alex: customer did re-use a slug from an old trial org — clearmap used to exist internally and the archiver job renamed it `archive-proj-031`. looks like the provisioner matched the archived slug first.

emily: not great. root cause = slug collision + provisioner matching by slug rather than unique tenant id. we should avoid relying on slug only.

ryan: immediate remediation options:
- rebind the key to `clearmap-prod` via the admin patch API (manual, quick)
- or revoke the archived-project key and re-run the provisioner so it creates a new key under the correct project

alex: performed manual rebind with admin patch: `PATCH /internal/keys/sk_live_3xAMPLEKEY {"project":"clearmap-prod"}` then validated with the same curl above — customer now gets 200 and token works.

maria: can you post the successful response? and file incident/ticket so infra can prevent future slug collisions?

alex: success response snippet:
```json
{"id":"resp-9a8","model":"redwood-alpha","output":"Hi!"}
```

onboard-bot: support-case-created case_id=CASE-7891 title=\"Provisioner bound key to archived project for clearmap\" assignee=infra-onboarding

dev-support-bot: note: flagged provisioning logs for claim-0b12 around 2024-10-05T14:22:31Z, retry_count=2, matched_project=archive-proj-031

emily: action items:
1) infra: add a hard check in the provisioner to prefer exact tenant ID matching and fall back to slug only as last resort (ASSIGN infra-onboarding)
2) product/console: add a warning when a key surfaces under an archived project and suggest verification (ASSIGN product-surface)
3) support: when onboarding failures reported, ask for `admin key lookup` output (we should add to KB)

maria: i'll create a KB snippet and link CASE-7891. alex — can you confirm customer has tested and is unblocked?

alex: confirmed with clearmap PM, they ran 20 requests, all successful. closing on our side. told them we've filed CASE-7891 and will follow up with timeline for fix. :thumbsup:

emily: thanks team. leaving this thread open until infra posts a patch PR.

alex: marking follow-up: add a monitoring alert to detect keys created in archived projects for last 90 days.

ryan: noted. I'll also add a check to prevent automatic binding when `project.status==archived`.

maria: thanks everyone.
